about: The painters' room on the first floor (the model's se-round-room-1; Interiors' docs/interiors/se-round-room-1.md): its two finished portraits and who sits in them by the clock. People's req 897, Godric's 1 on people-painters-sitters-r1-1022 (22 October 2026), the table in docs/handoff/people.md, *The painters' room's sitters*, *When home*. Every year, no occasion changing it. Morning and day both sitters are out and the room says nothing (the chair empty, the cup left, as Interiors built it); at evening the tea witch is home; at night both are home asleep. The drawing is the Architect's, req 927, cells 1 (the tea witch awake), 2 (her asleep) and 4 (the young wizard asleep) on these strings; the young wizard awake (cell 3) shows in no state.

show: the tea witch back in her portrait's carved chair, awake, her cup in her hand and the chair's arm bare
room.canon: People's req 897 and Events' req 928 (docs/handoff/people.md, *The painters' room's sitters*, *When home*; Godric's 1 on people-painters-sitters-r1-1022), every year, no occasion changing it: at evening the tea witch is home, awake, her cup in her hand (the arm bare); the young wizard is out, so no line for him. The Architect draws cell 1 of painters-sitters.png on this string (req 927). Two ordinary sitters of the castle's past, unnamed, nobody of canon (the world rules: Canon, traces never re-creations)

show: the tea witch asleep in her portrait's carved chair, her chin on her shawl and her cup back on the chair's arm
the young wizard asleep in his portrait's carved chair, his soft hat tipped over his brow, the sketchbook on his knee
